title: canVoid is inverted: every non-admin may void, an admin listed first may not
evidence: Array.indexOf returns -1 (truthy) when the role is absent and 0 (falsy) when "admin" is the first element. app.js:32 gates the void request on this function. app.js:2 sets the user to roles ["viewer","billing"].
failing_case: The user `sam` with roles ["viewer","billing"]: indexOf returns -1, so canVoid returns true and the click at app.js:32 sends POST /api/invoices/void. A real admin with roles ["admin","viewer"] gets index 0, so canVoid returns false and the admin cannot void. An admin with ["viewer","admin"] gets index 1 and can. The rule says "Only admins may void" (guards.js:8) and the code does the opposite.
remediation: Return `user.roles.includes("admin")`, guard against a missing roles array, and add a test for no roles, admin first and admin last. Enforce the same rule on the server: this check only decides whether the browser sends the request, and the roles object at app.js:2 is client-held.

quote: const res = await fetch("/api/invoices", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify(lines) });
title: Send has no catch and no success feedback; a network failure is silent and a success looks like nothing happened
evidence: The fetch is awaited with no try/catch (app.js:26). A rejected fetch (offline, DNS, CORS) becomes an unhandled promise rejection and the user sees nothing. On res.ok the handler only increments an unused counter (app.js:28), so no confirmation appears, the lines stay in the list and the total stays.
failing_case: Go offline and press Send invoice: no message, console error only, so the user believes it was sent or is unsure. When online and the send succeeds: the page looks unchanged, so the user presses again and, because tooSoon never blocks, sends a duplicate. Same shape at app.js:33 for Void: no catch, no success message.
remediation: Wrap in try/catch/finally, show a visible status message in an aria-live region for sent, failed with cause, and offline, clear or lock the lines after success, and disable the buttons while pending.

title: validQuantity accepts empty, zero, negative, fractional and Infinity quantities
evidence: isNaN coerces its argument with Number(). Number("") and Number("  ") are 0, so isNaN is false. "-5", "1.5", "1e3" and "Infinity" all coerce to numbers. app.js:19 then pushes Number(qtyText) into lines with no further check. The price check `price > 0` also lets "Infinity" through.
failing_case: Leave Quantity blank and add a line: the line is stored with qty 0. Enter -5 with price 20: total becomes -100.00, a credit note sent through Send invoice. Enter Infinity: total shows Infinity. Enter 1.5 for a unit-counted item: accepted.
remediation: One parser that requires /^\d+$/ (or the allowed decimal form), converts once, checks Number.isSafeInteger and > 0, and returns the number. Apply the same check with Number.isFinite to price. Add tests for "", "-1", "1.5", "Infinity", "0".

title: tooSoon never blocks: lastSend is never updated, so the double-send guard is dead
evidence: `lastSend` is declared at guards.js:22 and read here. Nothing assigns it anywhere in guards.js or app.js. app.js:25 calls tooSoon() and app.js:28 only increments sentCount.
failing_case: Click Send invoice twice quickly (or press Enter twice on the focused button). Date.now() - 0 is far larger than 1000, so tooSoon() returns false both times. Two POSTs to /api/invoices go out before the first resolves, and the client is billed twice. The button is also not disabled while the request is pending.
remediation: Set an in-flight flag before the await and clear it in finally, and disable the button meanwhile. Send an idempotency key with each invoice so the server can reject a repeat.

title: Draft invoice lines live only in memory and cannot be edited or removed
evidence: No localStorage, no beforeunload warning, and no remove or edit control in render (app.js:7-9) or index.html.
failing_case: Enter 20 lines, then refresh or press Back: all lines are gone with no warning. Enter a wrong line (see the quantity bug above): there is no way to delete it except reloading and losing every other line.
remediation: Add a Remove button per line (labelled with the client name), persist the draft with a versioned, try-guarded save, and warn on unload when lines exist.

title: Each line's client name is a dead link to #
evidence: The anchor has href="#" and no handler anywhere in app.js. It is a tab stop and is announced as a link, but does nothing except scroll to top and add # to the URL. The title repeats the visible text.
failing_case: Keyboard user tabs through every line's client link, activates one with Enter, and the page jumps to the top with no result. Screen reader users hear N links that go nowhere.
remediation: Render the client as plain text, or make it a real link or button with a destination and a handler. Drop the redundant title.

quote: const total = lines.reduce((sum, l) => sum + l.qty * l.price, 0);
title: Invoice total is computed in render with floating-point money and unrounded prices
evidence: Prices are stored as typed (Number("1.005")), shown per line with toFixed(2) (app.js:8), but summed unrounded. The same rule is not available to the server payload at app.js:26, which sends raw floats.
failing_case: Three lines with price 0.005 and qty 1 show three lines of 0.01 (or 0.00 depending on rounding) while the total shows 0.02 (0.015 rounded); the visible lines do not add up to the total. Fractions of a cent also go to the server in the payload.
remediation: Move totals into one pure function that works in integer cents, rejects prices with more than two decimals at entry, and is the single source for both display and payload; test it.

title: Invalid quantity or price is silently dropped with no message
evidence: The submit handler returns with no UI change. index.html has no error element and the inputs have no aria-invalid or aria-describedby. Number("1,50") is NaN so a European decimal fails `price > 0`.
failing_case: Type price 1,50 and press Add line: nothing happens, the fields keep their values, and the user cannot tell which field is wrong. A whitespace-only Client passes `required` and is stored as an empty name, rendering a blank link.
remediation: Show an inline error per field ("Unit price must be a number such as 12.50"), set aria-invalid and aria-describedby, move focus to the first bad field, and reject an empty trimmed client.

title: Void is destructive, has no confirmation, and names no invoice
evidence: The click voids immediately. The POST has no body, so no invoice id or the on-screen draft is identified. index.html:24 styles Void identically to Send and places it beside it.
failing_case: A mis-click on Void (adjacent to the primary Send button, same style) sends the void request at once with no confirm or undo. The server cannot tell which invoice is meant from this request, so it voids whatever the session considers current.
remediation: Send the invoice id in the body, ask for confirmation naming that invoice, and give Void a distinct destructive style away from Send. Hide or disable it for users who lack the role.

title: escapeHtml does not escape quotes, but app.js puts its output inside a double-quoted attribute
evidence: app.js:8 builds `title="${escapeHtml(l.client)}"` and assigns the string with innerHTML. escapeHtml escapes only &, < and >. A double quote passes through unchanged and closes the attribute.
failing_case: Enter the Client value `" onmouseover="alert(document.cookie)` plus a valid quantity and price, then press Add line. The rendered markup is ``. Hovering the client link runs the attacker's script. The `autofocus onfocus` variant runs with no hover at all. The payload `` alone is safely escaped.
remediation: Escape `"` as `"` and `'` as `'` in escapeHtml, or build the list with createElement and textContent / setAttribute so no escaping is needed.
fix: not offerable: unbalanced brackets or quotes

title: A whitespace-only client passes the required check and is stored as an empty name
evidence: The browser's `required` (index.html:14) is satisfied by '   '. The handler trims it to '' and never re-checks (app.js:19 tests only qty and price). The line is pushed with client '' and render() shows an anchor with empty text.
failing_case: Type three spaces in Client, quantity 2, price 5, press Add line: a line with an empty, unclickable client name is added and will be sent.
remediation: Reject an empty trimmed client in the same validation step as qty and price, with a visible message.

title: Live region is replaced wholesale on every add, so a screen reader re-reads the whole list
evidence: render() sets list.innerHTML for every line each time (app.js:7), which replaces all child nodes inside an aria-live region. The total is in a separate <output> that is not tied to it.
failing_case: With 30 lines, adding the 31st can make a screen reader announce all 31 items again. No message says that a line was added or what the new total is.
remediation: Keep the list out of the live region and announce one short status string ("Added Acme, total 120.00") in a dedicated role=status element.
